info.title: songdrop
info.description:
Turns a link into audio files. Start a download with `POST /api/v1/jobs`, then
poll `GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}` or pass a `callback_url`.

Who asks is known: a person signed in on the page, or an app with its API key
(`X-Api-Key`, made in Settings → API keys). Each sees and changes their own
downloads, unless allowed everyone's; only an app's key may ask for a
`callback_url`.

Errors answer a 4xx or 5xx status with `{"detail": "<sentence>"}`. Times are
Unix seconds. The guide: [songdrop's docs](https://el-amine-404.github.io/batlab/songdrop/guide/api).

get.summary: Whether songdrop is set up, and who this is

post.summary: Make the first account, an admin, with the setup code
post.description: Only while nobody exists. The code is in songdrop's log, and given by `docker exec songdrop admin setup-code`. Signs the new admin in.

Sets the HttpOnly session cookie the page uses (30 days unused at
most). Apps use an API key instead. After 5 wrong tries in 15 minutes,
from one address or for one name, each try waits longer (429).

get.summary: Every job, newest first: one's own, or everyone's with the permission
get.description:
Answers an ETag: the page polls every second or two while something
runs, and gets a bodyless 304 while nothing changed.

post.description:
Queues the link and answers at once with the job. 400: a link songdrop
can't take; 403: a callback asked without an API key; 422: an option
that isn't valid.

delete.summary: Remove a finished job and its files
delete.description: Copies already in the output folder stay. 409 while it runs: cancel it first.

post.summary: Stop a queued or running job
post.description:
A queued job is cancelled at once; a running one stops within seconds,
keeping the songs it finished.

post.summary: Try a missing song again now
post.description:
`index` is the missing song's `index` in `errors`. Works in any state,
also after songdrop gave up. 404: the song has no link of its own; 409:
the job is running.

get.summary: Download a job's songs as one zip

patch.summary: Change some settings; the others keep their value
patch.description:
Applies to the next job and survives a restart. 422 with the reason when
a value isn't valid; nothing is changed then.

put.summary: Save a cookies.txt (the request body is the file)
put.description:
The body is the cookies.txt itself (Netscape format, at most 1 MB, with
youtube.com cookies): `curl -X PUT --data-binary @cookies.txt …`.
